name: Laigter
tagline: Tool to generate normal, specular, occlussion and parallax maps for 2D textures
blurb: Laigter is a tool that automatically generates maps for dynamic lighting effects in games.
description:
Laigter is a tool that automatically generates maps for dynamic lighting effects
in games. It allows normal, parallax, specular and occlusion map generation.
Also, it allows the user to preview how the effect will look ingame.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
